adopted_proofs.proof: The same18 interest types give36 customers, theta3=12 and actual034=(10,12,12),W34. Any second player can choose a different same-group topic to secure12, so a repeated first label cannot be prescribed. Same-group first two labels force the third distinct same-group topic, welfare36. With a mixed first pair the second player must get12, so the singleton-group10 can only be the first player; welfare34. The explicit full012 strategy gives all12 and achieves the tail-minimum lower bound36. Group permutations and exchange realize12 same-group and36 minority-first mixed ordered terminals,48 total,12 with a tail minimum. The exact cost2 and multiplier18/17 are fixed-input results, not a general constant or a count of full strategies.

The extra premise quantifies over every finite ANY witness cone with no strictly negative budget. Completeness gives universal TB-ANY. Adding an empty-cover label preserves local complete-SPE payoff sets: whenever any customer is coverable, a nonempty choice guarantees at least1/m and empty0 is never prescribed; fill first-empty mutually disjoint subtrees by backward induction and restrict conversely. At all-zero coverage every quantity is0. On the legal all-empty path, W0 and each prefix has no customer load, yielding the original-directory sum of independent r-player dynamic leader minima. This needs ANY, not actual-TB. Static v_r and dynamic Theta_r differ even on the4-client example. The conditional derivation is complete; neither antecedent nor POP is proved.

All12 real comparisons of the specified nine-client, two-player, three-label full strategy follow the displayed four rows. The same Exp clocks represent actual11 and true-deviation01 by g1=8(Y0-Y1)+ and g0=Y0+3(Y0-Y1)+. Thus X=5(Y0-Y1)+-Y0, EX3/2, negative exactly when Y0<5Y1/4. Splitting the r=Y0/Y1 integral at1 gives-1/4-1/36=-5/18. This refutes arbitrary weighting by the same clock, not the representation. Fixed deterministic IC coefficients may first be averaged; a random payoff representation factors when the auxiliary weight is independent. Neither establishes a unit sum of row coefficients.

In a fixed complete formal strategy cone every actual player can query a maximum K-size theme, with real same-strategy continuation and each covered customer denominator at mostm; hence u_i>=K/m>0 on every nonzero type vector. Scaling byu_i preserves the exact cone and strict ratios. The u_i1 slice has total mass<=sum theme sizes<=kK<=km and is nonempty using the all-interest type of massm. OPT is the maximum of the finitely many min(m,k)-label union rows, so the ratio optimization is exactly the finite maximum of the sliced LP objectives. Repeated actual labels have equal final payoff. Rational faces preserve strict real witnesses and ties under a common integer scale; no floating filter or finite strategy scan is promoted to a universal bound.

Fix precisely the same B,T,O and owner assignment in both sources. Hall-B saturates harmonic sourcesH_c/c. Remove cycles and decompose source-to-sink paths, then retain for each source only its ordinary mass1/c; capacities and nonnegative conservation survive. Incoming role mass uses only missing-ownerE shares1/(c+1), so outgoing plus sink equals bG+incoming<=bG+eE<=u-ell(O). All modifiedO marginals and owner-present error shares are reserved. Dividing a coveredE terminal equally amongc coverers adds1/[c(c+1)] to each error share, totaling1/c, whilec0 keeps a unit sink. This is for each leaf an appropriate flow, not one cross-leaf flow or two separately spendable A/B currencies.

The genuine last-two theorem gives both actual tail payoffs at least theta_n. If any global minimum occurs there, all players are at least theta_n, so W>=n theta_n including ties. For an existing W0<n theta_n, every complete strategy with W<=W0 must place all minima before the tail; replacing the entire strategy to put a minimum in the tail costs at leastn theta_n-W0. No fixed-terminal permutation assumption is used. Forn2 or zero coverage the strict antecedent is impossible.

The two-group Boolean potential has pure n-set value1, mixed(n-1)-set value-1 and otherwise0. Its prescribed all-distinct strategy pays every nonroot1 and root0 at every relevant history. Integer Mobius inversion fixes all repeated-count payoffs; K=6M+4 is a stronger valid bias than4M+1. The full-history embedding proof bounds every fresh-old bias gain by at least1/2 versus signed loss at most2M, and fills every repeated subtree. Distinct last backgrounds have valueKb+1. Splitting a repeated background, holding a fresh query unused, decreases the uniform-type query by at least1/3 per split, hence any repeated background has best reply>Kb+1. Thus theta_n=Kb+1 and W=n theta_n-1 for every integern>=3. The positive bias gives2W>OPT, and singleton types keep labels distinct. This pays only the general family part of the target; the independent36-client example is retained separately.

Finite complete local-SPE sets attain REP, so a TB budget with Theta is equivalent to the budget for every independent family of local leader witnesses. Nested histories do not require these separately quantified witnesses to glue. Each fixed full ordered action table gives rational homogeneous weak inequalities in nonnegative type mass. A strict real negative point has a nearby rational point on the same rational face preserving zeros, needed positive support and tie equations; one denominator scale yields distinct unit customers. The witnesses need only remain local SPEs and the comparison tuple need only stay legal, since Theta<=witnesspayoff and coverage(T)<=OPT suffice. Conversely a true counterexample supplies actual sigma, minimizers and an optimum tuple. Dropping precisely actual full-tree IC produces ANY completeness, not an actual-TB counterexample.

The full two-signal construction preserves the entire old zero-signal tree, not just the root leaf. New one-signal actions reset by the same(background,input) minimizer and satisfy u_tau>=d_tau(A)>=ell(b,A). In the last-three swap histories both final backgrounds equalp+t+q, and the two true last BRs minimize the respective second query. Their equal BR values giveE0; minimum comparisons give JQ,JT>=0 with exact denominatorsb(b+1), zero terms handled separately. This is enough for the two minimum inequalities and tie row of the81-row target, with global nonnegative J multipliers and a global signed E multiplier. It does not alone prove the other78 IC/price/cap rows or either hidden-variable projection, and produces no positive exact score. The contribution/remaining fields accurately preserve this boundary.

For real parameters from the same true three-maxima thresholds, A<=n+2,1<=a_j<=n,n>=2. The weight LP lower boundsA,n+max a,3n/2 and filling y_j in[a_j,S-n] attain S=max of those, at most2n. All core-external nonprivate incidence sets are pairs when there are three maxima, so this feasible full-pair solution pays every actual incidence. Multiplying its private/shared coefficients givesU-c<=S nu. Combining the separately proved all-history static floorW-c>=n nu yields the precise three-maxima OPT<=2W-c contribution. It neither supplies a2n solution for arbitrarys nor turns the fixed-a auxiliary primal extreme into a genuine SPE sharpness instance.
